gbp_usd_case.interpretation: The existing any-opposing-contributor veto was triggered by two research-only inverse-veto diagnostics. The veto was not loosened; its exact basis is now measured prospectively.

root_cause.snapshot_serialization_defect: The live ranking compactor omitted aggregate lineage and conflict-basis fields before the later serializer received each row.
root_cause.ledger_lineage_defect: Per-horizon what-if rows fell back to the representative raw forecast ID, allowing one source ID to be attributed to different reconstructed horizon directions and families.
root_cause.same_cycle_deduplication_defect: The in-memory open-horizon set stored a scalar after insert although lookups used a horizon-and-measurement-version tuple.

actions: Bound each reconstructed horizon to a deterministic SHA-256 aggregate signal ID derived from instrument, horizon, direction, and sorted contributor lineage.
Preserved raw source forecast ID separately from aggregate signal ID.
Published opposing contributor counts, execution eligibility, research-only status, family, model, lane, timeframe, and direction.
Passed the new fields through both ranking and snapshot compactors.
Started V5 only when the exact aggregate lineage contract is present; otherwise raw rows remain V4 transitional or legacy.
Keyed open-horizon deduplication by horizon and measurement version both before and after insertion.
unchanged_invariants: No practice order was submitted or closed.
No signal threshold, direction-conflict gate, proof gate, lifecycle state, authorization rule, position limit, or re-entry guard was loosened.
No historical row was deleted, rewritten, or relabeled as V5.
V4 remains preserved and excluded from current proof summaries because it contains mixed legacy and strict lineage.

warnings: Pytest cache directory was not writable; test execution and results were unaffected.
